title: AGQ: Action-Guided Ultra-Low-Bit Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.33074v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform tasks specified through natural-language instructions, but their large weight footprint challenges deployment on memory-constrained onboard platforms. Ultra-low-bit quantization reduces this footprint, yet preserving task performance and controlling weight recovery costs remain challenging. We propose Action-Guided Quantization, which combines action sensitivity with a measured proxy for weight recovery cost to allocate matrix bitwidths under storage budgets. Per-channel calibration compensates for quantization error, while a uniform bitwidth within each matrix preserves regular layouts. Bit-dependent grouped lossless coding reduces resident weight storage, and block-wise recovery limits temporary buffers. translated_title: AGQ：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的动作引导超低位宽量化
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型使机器人能够执行通过自然语言指令指定的任务，但其庞大的权重占用对在内存受限的机载平台上部署构成了挑战。超低位宽量化可以减少这种占用，但如何保持任务性能以及控制权重恢复成本仍然具有挑战性。我们提出动作引导量化（Action-Guided Quantization），该方法将动作敏感性与权重恢复成本的测量代理指标相结合，在存储预算下分配矩阵位宽。逐通道校准用于补偿量化误差，同时每个矩阵内统一的位宽保持了规整的布局。依赖位宽的分组无损编码减少了常驻权重存储，而逐块恢复则限制了临时缓冲区的使用。在LIBERO基准上，AGQ在W3位宽下达到92.7%的任务成功率，分别超过AWQ和GPTQ 1.2和3.7个百分点，并在W2.5下仍保持70.5%的成功率。
tldr: 该论文提出AGQ方法，通过将动作敏感性与权重恢复成本相结合来在存储预算下分配矩阵位宽，实现VLA模型的超低位宽量化，在LIBERO基准上W3位宽达到92.7%任务成功率，超越AWQ和GPTQ等现有方法。
en_tdlr: AGQ introduces an action-guided ultra-low-bit quantization method for VLA models that combines action sensitivity with a weight recovery cost proxy to allocate matrix bitwidths under storage budgets, achieving 92.7% task success at W3 on LIBERO and outperforming AWQ and GPTQ.
